result.reason: The operative language implements 12-month automatic renewals, permits Customer to opt out on 30 days’ written notice, and requires a Vendor reminder at least 60 days before renewal, satisfying the preferred renewal position. It minimally revises the original mechanics and preserves the existing bilateral non-renewal right. The stated Section 8.3 cap would satisfy the pricing requirement if that operative provision indeed caps increases at the lesser of CPI and 3%. Drafting is professional, though “thirty days’ advance written notice before” is slightly redundant.
